children: France's debt is expected to reach 119.3% of output in 2026, with the year likely to end with a budget deficit of 5.4%, the finance ministry said on Saturday.

The finance ministry expects the debt-to-GDP ratio to reach 121.7% in 2027 and the deficit to narrow to 5.0%, it said in a declaration to the High Council of Public Finance, the body tasked with evaluating revenue and expenditure forecasts in the government's budget proposal.
